title: QUIZ - 41
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Determine whether two algebraic expressions are equivalent for all variable values
questions.question: Are the expressions \( 9n + 7 \) and \( 7 + 9n \) equivalent for all values of n?

options.label: C
options.text: They are equal only when n = 1.

options.label: D
options.text: They are equal only when n = 0.

questions.explanation: Testing n = 2: \( 9n + 7 \) = 25, \( 7 + 9n \) = 25. Since these expressions simplify to the same form for every value, they are equivalent.
questions.hint: Compare the simplified forms of both expressions, or test a value to check they always match.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the expanded form equivalent to a factored expression
questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to \( 6(n + 2) \)?
questions.explanation: Distributing 6 across (n + 2) gives 6n + 12, which is equivalent to the original expression for every value of n.
questions.hint: Two expressions are equivalent when they produce the same value for every possible input.
